notablePrerequisites: You control two lands that collectively tap for enough to cast Dualcaster Mage.
easyPrerequisites: There is a creature on the battlefield.
description:
Cast Snap by paying {1}{U}, targeting any creature.
With the original Snap on the stack, cast Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage ETB, causing you to create a copy of Snap and change its target to Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Snap, returning Dualcaster Mage to your hand and untapping two lands that produce enough to recast it.
Repeat from step 2.
